configuration.apiUrl.description: URL of an external OpenCode API server. Leave empty to auto-start a local instance.
configuration.opencodeBinary.description: Optional absolute path to the opencode CLI binary. Useful if PATH lookup fails. Requires window reload or API restart to apply.
walkthrough.gettingStarted.title: Get Started with OpenChamber
walkthrough.gettingStarted.description: Set up OpenChamber in VS Code and start chatting with your codebase.
walkthrough.gettingStarted.steps.openSid: Click the OpenChamber icon in the Activity Bar to open the chat sidebar.
Open the OpenChamber sidebar from the Activity Bar to access chat.
walkthrough.gettingStarted.steps.install: OpenChamber uses the OpenCode CLI locally. Install it if you have not already.
Run `curl -fsSL https://opencode.ai/install | bash` in your terminal, then restart the API connection if prompted.
walkthrough.gettingStarted.steps.configu: If OpenCode is not detected automatically, set the absolute path to the `opencode` binary in OpenChamber settings.
Open Settings from the chat view title bar or set `openchamber.opencodeBinary` in VS Code Settings.
walkthrough.gettingStarted.steps.startCh: Create a new session and ask OpenChamber about your code, files, or tasks.
Use **New Session** in the chat view to begin. Add files to context with editor commands or the explorer context menu.
